comment: TEMPLATE — copy this file to data/survey-samples.json and replace these entries with real properties whose wall area you know from a survey. Entries with a `comment` key are ignored, so this header stays out of the results. Run: npm run validate

FULL SAMPLE — a real photo's /api/detect output plus the surveyed answer. This exercises the whole pipeline, detection quality included. Paste the `detections` array straight from the API response, and set aspectRatio to the photo's width/height.
label: 12 Example Road (full)

comment: GEOMETRY-ONLY SAMPLE — no photo needed. Checks the front-to-total multiplier on its own, without detection error in the way. Useful when you have a floor plan or a surveyor's figures but no usable photo. wallHeightM is optional and defaults to storeys x 2.6 m.
label: 3 Example Terrace (plan only)

comment: houseType must be one of: detached, semi, endTerrace, terrace. Note that mid-terrace and end-of-terrace differ by roughly 70% in wall area, so recording which one it is matters more than any other field here.
